# First-party translation units the `host` preset does not compile, so the
# `tidy` job has no compile command for them. A changed .c/.cpp that is neither
# in build/host/compile_commands.json nor listed here fails the job, which keeps
# gaps in tidy coverage visible. Remove a line once its TU builds in `host`
# (most of these need RT64 or generated code; see host-full-nogen in the plan).
# Paths are repo-relative, one per line, exact match.
